historical_claims.anchor: The unrestricted ambient problem includes internal source and complement motions, and those motions can couple principal planes.
This supplies two acute real subspaces, an admissible orthogonal transporter, and a specific invariant norm for which the direct rotation loses.
Thus the printed general statement about every invariant norm of unsquared ambient displacement cannot be correct.
